env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos build -gcflags='-m -m' -O=3 .
stderr 'can inline smallEven with cost'
stderr 'can inline smallOdd with cost'
stderr 'can inline plainBig with cost'
stderr 'can inline midBig'
stderr 'cannot inline bigEven: function too complex: cost .* exceeds budget 80'
stderr 'cannot inline bigOdd: function too complex: cost .* exceeds budget 80'

logos build -gcflags='-m -m -d=inlrecursivebudget=400' -O=3 .
stderr 'can inline bigEven with cost'
stderr 'cannot inline hugeEven'
stderr 'cannot inline hugeOdd'

logos build -gcflags='-m -m' -O=2 .
stderr 'can inline tiny'
stderr 'can inline smallPlain'
stderr 'can inline plainBig'
stderr 'cannot inline midBig'
stderr 'cannot inline bigEven'

logos build -gcflags='-m -m' -O=s .
stderr 'can inline tiny'
stderr 'can inline smallPlain'
stderr 'can inline smallEven'
stderr 'cannot inline plainBig'
stderr 'cannot inline midBig'
logos run -O=3 ./cmd
stdout '^42$'
stdout '^5 6$'
stdout '^95$'
stdout '^415413 6902622878173$'
stdout '^1683910 1683911$'
cp stdout $WORK/rec-o3.txt
logos run -O=2 ./cmd
cp stdout $WORK/rec-o2.txt
cmp $WORK/rec-o3.txt $WORK/rec-o2.txt
logos run -O=s ./cmd
cp stdout $WORK/rec-os.txt
cmp $WORK/rec-o3.txt $WORK/rec-os.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com/inlrec

go 1.27

-- rec.go --
package rec

func smallEven(n int) int {
	if n <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return smallOdd(n - 1)
}

func smallOdd(n int) int {
	if n <= 0 {
		return 1
	}
	return smallEven(n-1) + 1
}

func bigWork(x int) int {
	a1 := x + 1
	a2 := a1 * 2
	a3 := a2 - 3
	a4 := a3 + a2
	a5 := a4 * a1
	a6 := a5 - a4
	a7 := a6 + 7
	a8 := a7 * 3
	a9 := a8 - a7
	a10 := a9 + a8
	a11 := a10 * 2
	a12 := a11 - 5
	a13 := a12 + a11
	a14 := a13 * a12
	a15 := a14 - a13
	return a15 + x
}

func bigEven(n int) int {
	if n <= 0 {
		return bigWork(n)
	}
	return bigOdd(n-1) + bigWork(n)
}

func bigOdd(n int) int {
	if n <= 0 {
		return bigWork(n) + 1
	}
	return bigEven(n-1) + bigWork(n)
}

func plainBig(x int) int {
	a1 := x + 1
	a2 := a1 * 2
	a3 := a2 - 3
	a4 := a3 + a2
	a5 := a4 * a1
	a6 := a5 - a4
	a7 := a6 + 7
	a8 := a7 * 3
	a9 := a8 - a7
	a10 := a9 + a8
	a11 := a10 * 2
	a12 := a11 - 5
	a13 := a12 + a11
	a14 := a13 * a12
	a15 := a14 - a13
	return a15 + x
}

func hugeEven(n int) int {
c1 := n + 1
c2 := c1 * 2
c3 := c2 - 3
c4 := c3 + c2
c5 := c4 * c1
c6 := c5 - c4
c7 := c6 + 7
c8 := c7 * 3
c9 := c8 - c7
c10 := c9 + c8
c11 := c10 * 2
c12 := c11 - 5
c13 := c12 + c11
c14 := c13 * c12
c15 := c14 - c13
d1 := c15 + 1
d2 := d1 * 2
d3 := d2 - 3
d4 := d3 + d2
d5 := d4 * d1
d6 := d5 - d4
d7 := d6 + 7
d8 := d7 * 3
d9 := d8 - d7
d10 := d9 + d8
d11 := d10 * 2
d12 := d11 - 5
d13 := d12 + d11
d14 := d13 * d12
d15 := d14 - d13
e1 := d15 + 1
e2 := e1 * 2
e3 := e2 - 3
e4 := e3 + e2
e5 := e4 * e1
e6 := e5 - e4
e7 := e6 + 7
e8 := e7 * 3
e9 := e8 - e7
e10 := e9 + e8
e11 := e10 * 2
e12 := e11 - 5
e13 := e12 + e11
e14 := e13 * e12
e15 := e14 - e13
f1 := e15 + 1
f2 := f1 * 2
f3 := f2 - 3
f4 := f3 + f2
f5 := f4 * f1
f6 := f5 - f4
f7 := f6 + 7
f8 := f7 * 3
f9 := f8 - f7
f10 := f9 + f8
f11 := f10 * 2
f12 := f11 - 5
f13 := f12 + f11
f14 := f13 * f12
f15 := f14 - f13
if n <= 0 {
return bigWork(n) + f15
}
return hugeOdd(n-1) + bigWork(n) + f15
}

func hugeOdd(n int) int {
g1 := n + 1
g2 := g1 * 2
g3 := g2 - 3
g4 := g3 + g2
g5 := g4 * g1
g6 := g5 - g4
g7 := g6 + 7
g8 := g7 * 3
g9 := g8 - g7
g10 := g9 + g8
g11 := g10 * 2
g12 := g11 - 5
g13 := g12 + g11
g14 := g13 * g12
g15 := g14 - g13
h1 := g15 + 1
h2 := h1 * 2
h3 := h2 - 3
h4 := h3 + h2
h5 := h4 * h1
h6 := h5 - h4
h7 := h6 + 7
h8 := h7 * 3
h9 := h8 - h7
h10 := h9 + h8
h11 := h10 * 2
h12 := h11 - 5
h13 := h12 + h11
h14 := h13 * h12
h15 := h14 - h13
i1 := h15 + 1
i2 := i1 * 2
i3 := i2 - 3
i4 := i3 + i2
i5 := i4 * i1
i6 := i5 - i4
i7 := i6 + 7
i8 := i7 * 3
i9 := i8 - i7
i10 := i9 + i8
i11 := i10 * 2
i12 := i11 - 5
i13 := i12 + i11
i14 := i13 * i12
i15 := i14 - i13
j1 := i15 + 1
j2 := j1 * 2
j3 := j2 - 3
j4 := j3 + j2
j5 := j4 * j1
j6 := j5 - j4
j7 := j6 + 7
j8 := j7 * 3
j9 := j8 - j7
j10 := j9 + j8
j11 := j10 * 2
j12 := j11 - 5
j13 := j12 + j11
j14 := j13 * j12
j15 := j14 - j13
if n <= 0 {
return bigWork(n) + j15 + 1
}
return hugeEven(n-1) + bigWork(n) + j15
}

func tiny(x int) int {
return x + 1
}

func midBig(x int) int {
m1 := x + 1
m2 := m1 * 2
m3 := m2 - 3
m4 := m3 + m2
m5 := m4 * m1
m6 := m5 - m4
m7 := m6 + 7
m8 := m7 * 3
m9 := m8 - m7
m10 := m9 + m8
m11 := m10 * 2
m12 := m11 - 5
m13 := m12 + m11
m14 := m13 * m12
m15 := m14 - m13
m16 := m15 + 1
m17 := m16 * 2
m18 := m17 - 3
m19 := m18 + m17
m20 := m19 * m16
m21 := m20 - m19
m22 := m21 + 7
m23 := m22 * 3
m24 := m23 - m22
m25 := m24 + m23
m26 := m25 * 2
return m26 + x
}

func smallPlain(x int) int {
p1 := x + 1
p2 := p1 * 2
p3 := p2 - 3
p4 := p3 + p2
p5 := p4 * p1
p6 := p5 - p4
p7 := p6 + 7
p8 := p7 * 3
p9 := p8 - p7
return p9 + x
}

-- drive.go --
package rec

import "fmt"

func Drive() {
	fmt.Println(tiny(41))
	fmt.Println(smallEven(10), smallOdd(10))
	fmt.Println(smallPlain(3))
	fmt.Println(plainBig(3), midBig(3))
	fmt.Println(bigEven(4), bigOdd(4))
}

-- cmd/main.go --
package main

import rec "example.com/inlrec"

func main() {
	rec.Drive()
}
